**Weave Reality (Su):** The reality sculptor gains an additional daily use of weave reality at 7th level. In addition, she gains access to the following weave reality options.

- **Sculpt Creature:** At 7th level, the reality sculptor can spend a use of weave reality to alter a creature as if with alter self. If the creature is unwilling, it can negate the effect with a successful Fortitude saving throw. At 10th level, this can instead function as polymorph. This weave reality option replaces the silhouette gained at 7th level. Sculpt Matter: At 10th level, the reality sculptor can spend a use of weave reality to revise matter as if with the spell fabricate. This weave reality option replaces energy duality.
- **Realize Transmutation:** At 16th level, the reality sculptor can spend a use of weave reality as a standard action to replace any spell with false transmutation in its name with the transmutation spell it imitates with the same remaining duration. If the transmutation spell requires material or focus components, she must provide those components. A creature that was unaffected due to disbelief gets a new saving throw against the realized spell, if the transmutation normally allows one. This weave reality option replaces overrule reality.

**Avid Learner:** A reality sculptor can learn transmutation spells with avid learner, but not evocation or illusion spells.

This ability alters avid learner.

**Actualize Transmutation (Su):** At 20th level, the reality sculptor's shadow spells that emulate transmutations are 100% real; they can't be disbelieved. If an imitated transmutation spell requires material or focus components costing 1 gp or more, the reality sculptor must provide those components to modify its illusory version with this ability.

This ability replaces perspective actualization.
